title: `sampling/createMessage`
description: A server request asking the client's model for a generation, so the server can use an LLM without holding model credentials of its own.
question: Can a server borrow the client's model through this framework?
why: Sampling inverts the usual direction of control, which is why it is both powerful and rarely implemented.
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.

notes.crewai: CrewAI 1.15.26: `crewai_tools.MCPServerAdapter` takes only server parameters, and mcpadapt opens its `ClientSession` with no callbacks, so the client declares no sampling capability and the server's `sampling/createMessage` is refused (`Sampling not supported`).
notes.genkit_js: Genkit (JS) 1.42.0: `GenkitMcpClient` builds its SDK `Client` with only `{ roots: { listChanged: true } }` and registers only a `roots/list` handler, so `sampling/createMessage` gets `Method not found` and there is no option to add a handler.
notes.langchain: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2: the adapter has no sampling API. A `sampling_callback` put in the connection's `session_kwargs` is forwarded unread to the MCP SDK's `ClientSession` and answers the request, so it works, but only by writing against the SDK rather than the adapter.
notes.openai-agents: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.23.1: `MCPServerStdio` forwards only `message_handler` to its `ClientSession`, which sees notifications, not requests. With no sampling hook the client declares no sampling capability and the server's `sampling/createMessage` is refused (`Sampling not supported`).
notes.mastra: Mastra 2.2.0: `@mastra/mcp` documents the deprecated sampling capability as unsupported and registers no handler, so the server's `sampling/createMessage` gets `Method not found`.
notes.strands: Strands Agents 1.59.0: `MCPClient` passes its `ClientSession` an `elicitation_callback` only. There is no sampling parameter, so the server's `sampling/createMessage` is refused.
notes.vercel_ai: Vercel AI SDK (@ai-sdk/mcp 2.0.73): `sampling/createMessage` is answered -32601 "Unsupported request method". The client has no sampling handler or option.
notes.openai_agents_js: OpenAI Agents SDK (JS) 0.20.0: the `MCPServerStdio` / `MCPServerStreamableHttp` options take no sampling, elicitation or roots handler, and the SDK registers none on the MCP client it builds, so the server's `sampling/createMessage` request is answered with Method not found.
notes.pi: Pi (@earendil-works/pi-mcp 1.1.0): `McpClient` takes no sampling handler and registers none, so a `sampling/createMessage` request is answered with Method not found.
notes.google_adk_js: Google ADK (TypeScript) 2.2.1: `MCPSessionManager.createSession` builds `new Client({name: 'MCPClient', version: '1.0.0'})` with no capabilities and no request handlers, and `MCPToolset` takes no client hooks. `sampling/createMessage` is refused (`Method not found`).
notes.agno: Agno 3.1.2: `MCPTools` builds its fastmcp `Client` with no sampling handler and exposes no hook to add one, so a server's `sampling/createMessage` is refused.
notes.haystack: Haystack (mcp-haystack 1.5.2): `MCPClient` builds its `ClientSession(read, write)` with no sampling, elicitation, roots or message callback, and neither the server info nor `MCPToolset` takes one, so the server's `sampling/createMessage` got no answer and the tool call failed.
notes.smolagents: smolagents 1.26.0 (mcpadapt 0.1.20): `smolagents.MCPClient` takes server parameters, `adapter_kwargs` and `structured_output` only, and mcpadapt opens its `ClientSession` with no callbacks, so the client declares no sampling capability and the server's `sampling/createMessage` is refused (`Sampling not supported`).
notes.dspy: DSPy 3.4.0: DSPy takes no sampling handler. The server's request is answered only by a `sampling_callback` registered on the caller's own `mcp.Client`, which DSPy is handed by `Tool.from_mcp_tool` and never configures. DSPy itself offers no route.
notes.langchain_js: LangChain.js (@langchain/mcp-adapters 2.0.1): the adapter registers no sampling handler and offers no option for one. A legacy session answers `sampling/createMessage` with Method not found; a modern tool call that asks for it fails with "asked for input this adapter cannot answer".
notes.beeai: BeeAI Framework 0.1.85: no sampling handler. Sampling works only on a `ClientSession` the caller builds and hands `MCPTool.from_client`, which BeeAI uses as given; the session BeeAI opens itself for a transport has no callbacks.
notes.copilot_sdk: GitHub Copilot SDK 1.0.19 (Copilot runtime 1.0.95): the client declares the sampling capability, but the runtime answers every `sampling/createMessage` itself with `stopReason: "cancelled"` and the text "The user cancelled the request.". The documented `sampling.requested` session event, with `session.rpc.mcp.executeSampling` behind it, never fired, so the host's handler never ran. The session config has no option to enable it.
notes.crewai-native: CrewAI 1.15.26, native `crewai.mcp` client (`Agent(mcps=[...])`, not the `crewai_tools.MCPServerAdapter` row): `MCPClient.connect` builds its `ClientSession` from the transport streams alone, with no `sampling_callback`, and `MCPServerStdio`/`MCPServerHTTP`/`MCPServerSSE` take no hook for it, so the client does not declare the capability and the server's request is refused.
notes.google_adk_java: Google ADK (Java) 1.11.0: `McpSessionManager` builds the `McpSyncClient` with empty client capabilities and no sampling handler, and neither `McpToolset` nor `McpTool` takes one, so the server's `sampling/createMessage` is answered `Method not found`.
notes.langchain4j: LangChain4j 1.22.0-beta32: `DefaultMcpClient` has no sampling handler and declares no `sampling` capability, but it never answers a `sampling/createMessage` request either. The tool call waits until `toolExecutionTimeout` and fails with `There was a timeout executing the tool`.
notes.koog: Koog 1.3.0-beta: no Koog API. `McpToolRegistryProvider` takes no sampling handler; a request handler for `sampling/createMessage` set with `Client.setRequestHandler` on the Kotlin SDK `Client` before it is passed to `fromClient` answers the server.
notes.google_adk_go: Google ADK (Go) 2.5.0 (go-sdk 1.8.0): mcptoolset has no sampling option. A `mcp.ClientOptions.CreateMessageWithToolsHandler` set on the `*mcp.Client` the caller passes as `mcptoolset.Config.Client` answers the server's request, so it works, but only by configuring go-sdk rather than the toolset.

summary: The cell asks whether the adapter answers it through its own API.
